verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents an AI question-answering feature that returns answers with citations from workspace content. Enterprise search is a single search bar, not an AI-generated answer. Rovo AI is described as connecting assets to work and identifying trends, which are related features but not cited Q&A. These count only as adjacent features, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask AI a question and get an instant answer with citations from my workspace content

citations.quote: Use enterprise search to find anything across Jira, Confluence, and any connected app from a single search bar.
Rovo AI connects relevant assets and rich data from Confluence, Figma, and your 3rd party apps to your work.
